name: Shinsetsu Kamiya Ukyou ~Zouge no Tou~
original_name: 真説 神谷右京 ～象牙の塔～
source:
In 1985 fund regulation law was enforced and there are many companies that fall under its jurisdiction. You need to gain consent from one of such funds.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-january-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1985年《基金管理法》实施，管辖的公司很多。你需要获得此类基金之一的同意。
